# Crisis 1: Ottoman Imperial Decline (奥斯曼帝国衰微危机)
oe_wp35_crisis_ottoman_decline = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = yes

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		tag = TUR
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year >= 1580
		num_locations >= 80
		OR = {
			stability < 5
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			inflation >= 0.08
			AND = {
				current_year >= 1620
				legitimacy < 60
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { tag = TUR }
			num_locations < 30
			AND = {
				stability >= 25
				legitimacy >= 75
				is_during_bankruptcy = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_tur_reform_steps }
					var:oe_wp35_tur_reform_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		global_monthly_control = -0.004
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.12
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.003
		discipline = -0.025
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_tur_reform_steps value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			4 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			96 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_ev_cd } }
				random_list = {
					96 = { }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.2 }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.4
	}
}

# Crisis 2: Habsburg Dual Succession Stress (哈布斯堡双重继承危机)
oe_wp35_crisis_habsburg_succession = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/time_of_troubles.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = yes

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		OR = { tag = HAB has_or_had_tag = HAB }
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year >= 1520
		current_year <= 1760
		num_locations >= 25
		OR = {
			stability < 10
			legitimacy < 65
			has_heir = no
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_year > 1775
			NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
			AND = {
				stability >= 20
				legitimacy >= 80
				has_heir = yes
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_hab_sanction_steps }
					var:oe_wp35_hab_sanction_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.08
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.08
		diplomatic_reputation = -1.0
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.002
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_hab_sanction_steps value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.5
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			4 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			96 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_ev_cd } }
				random_list = {
					96 = { }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.6 }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.7 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.8
	}
}

# Crisis 3: Polish Magnate Partition Crisis (波兰贵族割据与瓜分危机)
oe_wp35_crisis_polish_partition = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = yes

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		OR = { tag = POL tag = PLC }
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year >= 1650
		num_locations >= 30
		any_neighbor_country = {
			count >= 2
			is_subject = no
			num_locations >= 35
		}
		OR = {
			stability < 10
			legitimacy < 60
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			num_locations < 15
			AND = {
				stability >= 25
				legitimacy >= 75
				is_during_bankruptcy = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_pol_reform_steps }
					var:oe_wp35_pol_reform_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		global_crown_estate_power = -0.12
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.12
		discipline = -0.03
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.15
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_pol_reform_steps value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.9
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			4 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			96 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_ev_cd } }
				random_list = {
					96 = { }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.10 }
					2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_wp35_gp.11 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_gp.12
	}
}
